alt: 破舊小屋裡，大人打開空錢袋，孩子坐在幾乎沒有食物的鍋子和空碗旁，櫥櫃只剩少許碎屑。
scene_prompt: Inside a visibly impoverished small home with cracked plaster and a patched leaking roof, an adult and child sit beside an almost empty cooking pot and two bare bowls. The adult holds an empty coin purse open toward the viewer; a tiny open food cupboard behind them has only a few crumbs. Their clean but repeatedly mended clothes and a thin blanket on a simple floor mat convey severe lack of basic resources. Compassionate dignified faces, no comic exaggeration, no begging stereotypes, no luxurious minimalist design.
